18:62.text: So when they had passed further on
said to his boy-servant: "Bring us our morning meal; truly, we have suffered much fatigue in this, our journey."

18:63.text: He said: "Do you remember when we betook ourselves to the rock? I indeed forgot the fish; none but Shaitân
made me forget to remember it. It took its course into the sea in a strange

18:64.text: said: "That is what we have been seeking." So they went back retracing their footsteps.

18:65.text: Then they found one of Our slaves, on whom We had bestowed mercy from Us, and whom We had taught knowledge from Us.

18:66.text: : "May I follow you so that you teach me something of that knowledge

18:67.text: said: "Verily you will not be able to have patience with me!

18:68.text: "And how can you have patience about a thing which you know not?"

18:69.text: said: "If Allâh wills, you will find me patient, and I will not disobey you in aught."

18:70.text: said: "Then, if you follow me, ask me not about anything till I myself mention of it to you."

18:71.text: So they both proceeded, till, when they embarked the ship, he
said: "Have you scuttled it in order to drown its people? Verily, you have committed a thing "Imr"

18:72.text: said: "Did I not tell you, that you would not be able to have patience with me?"

18:73.text: said: "Call me not to account for what I forgot,
and be not hard upon me for my affair

18:74.text: Then they both proceeded, till they met a boy, and he
said: "Have you killed an innocent person who had killed none? Verily, you have committed a thing Nukr
(a great Munkar - prohibited, evil, dreadful thing)
